hebrewText: וְ/רָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֥ן אֶ֨בֶן֙ קָהָ֔ל וּ/בָרֵ֥א אוֹתְ/הֶ֖ן בְּ/חַרְבוֹתָ֑/ם בְּנֵי/הֶ֤ם וּ/בְנֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ וּ/בָתֵּי/הֶ֖ן בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ

tokens.bdb: to cast together (stones), i.e. to lapidate
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.kjv: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).

tokens.bdb: (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes)
tokens.kjv: choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).
tokens.explanation: bara — criar ex nihilo (do nada), ato exclusivo de Deus no AT

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, [idiom] first, [idiom] old, [phrase] owl, town, village.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.enLiteralWord: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanation: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship
tokens.explanationEn: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship

tokens.kjv: destroy, out of hand, kill, murder(-er), put to (death), make (slaughter), slay(-er), [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.kjv: (cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, [idiom] utterly.
